svg.aria-label: Architecture: four shards, each with its own tun queue, stack and CPU core
svg.text: One process, N shards. Each shard owns one tun queue, one stack and one CPU core.
① The kernel hashes each flow's 4-tuple to one queue, and learns the reply queue from our writes.
② Shards share nothing: no locks, no atomics. A connection never leaves its shard.
